programs.title: Tony Robinson's Marvellous Machines
programs.desc: Atomic clocks, airport vehicles, large heavy-duty monsters, humanoid robots, a jet-powered suit - these are just some of the innovative machines, structures and vehicles presented by Tony Robinson.Actor known, among others,from the cult series "Blackadder" travels around the world in pursuit of these fantastic inventions and talks to the scientists and engineers who created them. He visits factories, workshops and laboratories to learn the principles of operation and look at the work of machines that perform necessary and extremely difficult tasks, and whose existence we are often unaware of.

programs.title: Secrets of the Bermuda Triangle
programs.desc: Legends still circulate about the Bermuda Triangle.This is one of the most famous and unknown areas on the planet.For years, it has been associated with the inexplicable disappearance of ships and planes that appear in a 500-square-mile stretch of the Atlantic Ocean.Researchers are constantly exploring this mystery, creating probable and paranormal theories.In a three-episode series, the creators will analyze the causes of the secret disappearances of aircraft and ships.Perhaps this is due to human errors, unfavorable weather conditions or the appearance of UFOs.

programs.title: Disasters Engineered
programs.desc: A series devoted to the greatest engineering disasters in the history of mankind.Chernobyl, Titanic and Hinderburg - these are examples of bold technological experiments that ended tragically.

programs.title: Top Gear: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
programs.desc: A carefully selected compilation of fragments of 'Top Gear' episodes, in which Clarkson, Hammond and May travel across land and space by all possible means of transport.
